desc: When you Damage a Creature that does not Detect you, they become Stunned for Rounds equal to your Assassin.

name: Tainted Strikes
desc: You can transmit any Poison via an Attack, regardless of its normal transmission modality.

name: Lethal Jolt
desc: When you Strike a Creature that does not Detect you, they fall Prone.

name: Killers Intuition
desc: Against Creatures that do not Detect you, Major Injuries are lethal.

name: Mortal Blow
desc: When you succesfully Attack a Creature, you can suffer 1 Persistent Strain to expand your Critical Success range. You can do this as many times as you wish for the same Attack, potentially turning in…

name: Silver Tongue
desc: Creatures with Mind less than yours are Gullible for you. You have a Boon to Impress them, two if you're lying.

name: Liar's Sense
desc: When speaking with a Gullible Creature, you can loosely infer whether or not a lie is plausible to them, learning their Attitude, asking the GM before you'd Deceive them.

name: Countercharm
desc: If a Creature is lying to you, you know, just not what about. You can also treat Scrutiny as a Darkness Activity to find that out.

name: Internal Rehearsal
desc: You can Retract something you said within the last number of Seconds equal to twice your Guile. This retro-actively removes the sentence from the game entirely and replaces it with something harmless.

name: Sly
desc: You can infer Attitude even if the Target isn't Gullible.

name: Subversion
desc: A Gullible Creature you Communicate with must spend 1 AP doing whatever you wish, so long as it does not literally harm it, like a self-Attack. Walking into a hazard does not count as literal self-ha…

name: Slight of Hand
desc: You can Conceal an Item or Items on your person, with no more Bulk than your Skullduggery. These cannot be perceived by normal means, but edge cases like a cavity search or Magic might. Objects Conce…

name: Duck
desc: You slip out of Sight, combining with the next Action taken this Turn for the purpose of Stealth.

name: Dodge
desc: When Attacked, you can Maneuver away, potentially leaving its Range or blocking line of sight.

name: Continuity
desc: When you make a Stealthy Movement Action, you can include a Stealthy Interaction at any point in the Movement without stopping.

name: Flash
desc: You create a diversion which hides you from all Senses for the next Simple-Turn.

name: Blink
desc: You vanish entirely, intangible but unable to Act until the start of your next Turn. At such a time you emerge, you can be anywhere within Meters from the original Space up to your Skullduggery

name: The Mind Palace
desc: You have an internal memory model, your Mind Palace, that aids in memorizing things that others simply couldn't. Your Mind Palace allows you to record the exact contents of anything that could be wri…

name: Rushed Approach
desc: By suffering Strain, you can hasten the process of Memorization. This reduces the time needed to Memorize to 6 Seconds, or a 3 AP General Action.

name: Hardware
desc: You can externalize your Mind Palace, allowing you to replicate one of its Pages on a real Page in the same amount of time. Physical Pages can be used to add or remove things from your Mind Palace wi…

name: Brute Force
desc: When attempting to remember something not in your Mind Palace, you can make a Difficulty 16 Memory Test. If you succeed, the information is gained as Pages. If you fail, you cannot attempt this again…

name: Continuity
desc: If you have a physical Page from your Mind Palace on your person, you can treat it as if it were a mental Page.

name: The Second Mind
desc: Your Mind Palace's Page limit is doubled.

name: Academic Interest
desc: All kinds of information can be grouped under a Subject, a species of knowledge. Relative to any Subject, you have a Grasp, which quantifies your past academic experience with a Subject. Your Grasp o…

name: Applied Study
desc: When Gauging a Creature, you gain an Opening for them, a natural defect which you can Exploit. Exploiting an Opening Consumes it and grants you a Bonus equal to your Scholarship to a Test made agains…

name: Sparks of Insight
desc: Each time you Study a Subject, you gain a temporary Buff to your Grasp of it, equal to half the Opportunity spent. This Buff decays by 1 each Day.

name: Domain Knowledge
desc: If your Grasp of a Subject which studies a Creature is greater than their Tier, you always have an Opening for them.

name: Instruction
desc: By Communicating with an Ally as a 1 AP Reaction, you can give them one of your Openings. They only gain half the benefit of Exploiting it.

name: Return on Investment
desc: When you Exploit an Opening for a Test against a Creature whose Tier is less than your Grasp of a Subject that studies it, you can change a success into a critical success.

name: Coordination
desc: When you Flank, you can Coin-Flip to make the Target Off_Balance for 1 Simple-Turn.

name: Prediction
desc: You make a verbal (out loud) Prediction about an Enemy, such as "they will Attack (so and so)" or "you will Interact with (such and such)". If they follow your Prediction, they become Off_Balance for…

name: Group Action
desc: Members of your Plan gain a Boon which they can spend on Test made for its Duration.

name: Call Out
desc: When your Prediction is successful, the Target Risks Minor Panic. If they already were the Target of a successful Prediction, this is Moderate instead.

name: Double Time
desc: When you Execute a Plan, you can Coin Flip to keep it, instead of Consuming the Plan.

name: Demoralize
desc: When your Prediction is successful, you can Taunt them as a 1 AP Reaction. Taunting an Enemy provokes Minor Panic Risk from them, regardless of how many times you have already Predicted them. Each Ta…
